Subject: Introducing the Stormline Shell — built for the wet days you don't cancel
Preview: 20k/20k waterproof-breathable. 420 g. Ready when the weather isn't.
Body: Some trips get rained on. That's not a problem — unless your jacket can't keep up.

The Northbay Stormline Shell (NB-JKT-07) is built for sustained wet weather. Its 3-layer laminate construction holds a 20,000 mm waterproof rating, so water stays out across a full day of rain, not just a passing shower. The 20,000 g/m² breathability rating means you're not trading a wet outside for a soaked inside when you're moving hard on trail.

At 420 g, it packs light enough to carry without thinking twice.

A few honest notes: The Stormline is a shell — it's not insulated, so layer underneath in cold conditions. It's designed for trail and alpine wet weather, not submersion or extended technical climbing in ice.

If you've got a wet-weather trip on the calendar — or you should — the Stormline is worth a look.
